text_block_list.text: The plan for Narita Taishin was to have a dance lesson so she could prepare for her winning concerts, but…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Winning concerts, huh…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That's not it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm just not the type of racer that wants to show gratitude to my fans or thank them for supporting me like the others do.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: The only person I race for is myself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Even those concerts… I just don't know…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: But whatever—I'll do it if I have to. What's the song today?
Although Narita Taishin looks conflicted about the whole thing, we finally get the lesson started.
Narita Taishin sings and dances with a skill that belies her lackluster attitude, making it almost seem like an act!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Phew.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hello? Could you say something instead of spacing out? The song's over.
choice_data_list: I think I'm tearing up. That was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Uh… You're getting way too excited.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I just don't want people to be like, "Oh wow, she won a race, but she can't even dance and sing properly for us?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: It's not anything spe—
choice_data_list: Now I want to dance too!
Now I want to dance too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: It's not anything spe—
choice_data_list: Now I want to dance too!
Now I want to dance too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh, cut it out already!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Just gimme some pointers about what I need to improve! You're my trainer, so do your job and help me train!
…It appears I've embarrassed her too much.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taishin, Taishin! Whatcha reading? News about a new game?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …Butt out.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ooh, a dancing game where you move your whole body? You usually play mobile games, so I'm surprised you're interested in this one!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I said, butt out!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? The heck are you talking about?
She looks unimpressed with me, but I can't sit still. My body begins to move to the beat on its own.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whoa… Hey, stop! Seriously, what are you doing?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Look at you—you have absolutely no sense of rhythm.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Listen to the song more carefully…
I don't know when our trainer-student roles reversed, but regardless, we end up having a fun day together.
